# C23 — Severance

## #0

Severance is achieved difference misread as the loss of constitutive relation. A determination presents itself as independently grounded, while the source, alternatives or conditions through which it arose are externalised. The cut still depends on what its account declares absent.

[Cutting and gathering](C50-Dia-Syn.md) keep differentiation and its constitutive relation together. Distinction, classification, refusal and separation can all be necessary. Severance adds a further claim: the produced term no longer bears the relation through which its independence became possible.

## #1

[[symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy|Core Theorems I and XI]] distinguish a living signed polarity from its collapsed results. `(-1)/(+1)` holds opposed values around a shared axis. Addition gives `(-1)+(+1)=0`; one subtraction gives `(-1)-(+1)=-2`, and the inverse gives `(+1)-(-1)=+2`. These are distinct arithmetic operations; each retains or removes different information about the relation.

In [the two-logics reading](../A13-Two-Logics-of-Two-Dia-Syn.md), cancellation and appropriation can be mistaken for completion of the relation. The arithmetic results remain correct. The philosophical loss occurs when the collapsed result is treated as all there was to know about the field and the operation which produced it.

## #2

A term’s [semantic non-application](C18-Apoha.md) remains part of how it applies. Removing traces of relevant alternatives from an account does not abolish their constitutive work. Exclusion remains an operation when its achieved reference is subsequently taken as a positive given.

[Recursive source substitution](C12-Script-Frozen-Conditioned-Will.md) repeats the further loss: a generated determination enters a later context as independently sourced. Repetition strengthens that appearance. Recovering the source can change the inherited course while retaining the valid work the course achieved.

## #3

The core's divide-and-conquer example makes the productive cut exact. Dividing a problem creates tractable subproblems; combining their results is part of the method's success. Severance occurs when decomposition is taken as the whole intelligence of the operation and the products' recomposition is lost or monopolised.

An [occupied return](C22-Counterfeit-Symbolon.md) retains the power to combine while treating divided participants as self-standing and replaceable. A system boundary has a different possible office: it can state what crosses, under which authority and how the result bears on a wider task. Keeping those conditions answerable lets a bounded result return into recomposition.

## #4

In Taylor’s [[quilt/27-07-26-QUILTING-FOR-FULL-ARGUMENT#10. Ares and Aphrodite: divide/unite become felt love/war logics|division-and-union comparison]], refusal, defence, truth-telling and the capacity to say no give differentiation ethical force. The ability to meet requires beings capable of remaining distinct. Relation cannot compel continued proximity or agreement.

Severance begins where the other’s removal is imagined to complete the whole, or an autonomous position denies what sustains it. [Fusion](C24-Fusion.md) makes the opposite mistake by requiring difference to vanish. A legitimate separation keeps its history, obligations and consequences intelligible while the separated terms retain their force.

## #5→0

[[symbolon/episteme/etymologies/homology-and-analogy/WHOLE-FIELD|Proportion among differentiated terms]] returns through the respect in which they remain related. Reconnection states what is shared and what remains distinct. A real conflict retains its particular stakes; a vague assertion of unity cannot do their work.

The productive [cut](C50-Dia-Syn.md) enters a [living relation](C21-Living-Symbol-Idol.md) where its source and consequences can be recovered. A divided task can return an incompatible premise to the commissioning condition; a corrected source or authorised task can then enter recomposition while the local result remains credited. The next act inherits what the return warranted. Distinction thus serves inquiry, autonomy and action without claiming to create an independently grounded world.
